svg.aria-label: How CVForge works: in your browser, the app on 127.0.0.1 turns your CV into evidence, triages postings against it, records the gaps you really have, composes the kit only from cited evidence and verifies it in code. Everything is stored in a local SQLite file. Outside traffic goes to Anthropic's API with your own key, plus an opt-in daily version check.
